card.name: Partway into omen and foreshadow words
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the start of words that mean 'foretell' or 'omen', such as fo|reshadow, port|ending, good om|ens and ill-fated. It also fires on 'may' after 'signs which' when the signs are warnings.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward completing words like portending, presage and omens, i.e. word pieces such as port, pres, fo and om.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about a sign that foretells something, such as an omen or a warning symptom.
